notes.title: Hatchwell QoL Improvements update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416665/d72a079c5cd8e7e05a5c62ecfb39ad7c313672de.png

This last couple weeks was spent working on your feedbacks and today, I am happy to announce that version 2 is out! 


Version 2 includes Quality of Life improvements such as:

PLAY STYLE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416665/44617655dcc40d029411c74e4576906f40e16d77.png
You'll now be able to adjust the Play Style that you think is best for you when playing Hatchwell! You can adjust these anytime in the Settings Menu in game!


NEW MENU!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416665/14d60b4d71c6ace3595509897e1cd9e55cb95c38.png
The updated new look of the game's Menu includes a Quality of Life improvements as well! If you have already played the game prior to this update, you'll be welcomed with a nice quick info to tour you around!


SAVE WITH A KEY

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416665/a73ecbc8f42aa4cbc2053ccfc9cf23cadbf902e0.png
The Menu is now updated, moving a few things around. SAVING is now attached to a single button that you can press for easy access!


QUEST LOG AT A TIME

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416665/949c547245e8a437041eed3a84923e84c1256a11.png
Since time is moving in Hatchwell, so are the Townspeople! The Quest log in the Menu now enables you to see available quests at a certain time. 


QUEST INDICATOR

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416665/8abb5b85c66903357f5fa362e3a1cfc0c9d39d37.png
Townspeople with Side Quests are now indicated by a "?" above their heads! They are time limited as well! 



TIME MOVES

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416665/bf8b90160a19982661a38457c0538820efa129af.png
A NOTICE that time will move forward when...they move forward. So you'll have time to complete Time Limited Quests



OTHER UPDATES
For other updates, you can check the Update notes here:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1424690/view/3372647018503926624


Again, thank you soo much for playing the game!
- Adee

notes.title: Hatchwell Release Date: May 13, 2022
notes.notes:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41416665/945de0f276fb08cf05982c281616a14516be09c1.png

After more than 2 years of developing the game in my spare time, Hatchwell will be releasing on May 13, 2022. What a journey it has been! Thank you to all who followed the progress and thank you also to those who added the game in their wishlist! :) 

Please save the date and look forward to playing it in a couple of weeks.

- Adee
